{"test_name":"Ledger_2283_Objection2","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection2\n{\n    private static async Task<CSharpCompilation> CreateCompilationWithMetadataReferenceAsync(string libSource, string appSource)\n    {\n        var parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> baseReferences = net80Refs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpCompilation libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(libSource, parseOptions) },\n            baseReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using var libStream = new MemoryStream();\n        var emitResult = libCompilation.Emit(libStream);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n\n        MetadataReference libReference = MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(libStream.ToArray());\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> appReferences = baseReferences.Append(libReference);\n\n        return CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, parseOptions) },\n            appReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task MetadataPropertiesWithoutKey_InCompilingMessagePackObjectAndClosedGenericStruct_DoNotThrowAndGenerateResolver()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib\n            {\n                public class MetadataBase\n                {\n                    public int UnkeyedBaseProperty { get; set; }\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial record struct Item<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key)\n                {\n                    public int UnkeyedStructProperty { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using Lib;\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace App\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial class DerivedMessagePackObject : MetadataBase\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public int DerivedProperty { get; set; }\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n                {\n                    [Key(1)]\n                    public Item<int> Member { get; init; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = await CreateCompilationWithMetadataReferenceAsync(libSource, appSource);\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.Contains(runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources), s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n        Assert.Empty(output.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await compilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning);\n        Assert.All(analyzerDiagnostics, d =>\n        {\n            Assert.True(d.Location.IsInSource, $\"Unexpected non-source diagnostic: {d}\");\n            Assert.True(d.Location.SourceTree is not null && compilation.ContainsSyntaxTree(d.Location.SourceTree), $\"Diagnostic outside compilation: {d}\");\n        });\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task MetadataPropertiesWithNullKey_GetPropertyIdentifierLocationReturnsNull_DoesNotThrowOrReportInvalidLocation()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib\n            {\n                public class MetadataBaseWithNullKey\n                {\n                    [Key((string)null!)]\n                    public int NullKeyBaseProperty { get; set; }\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial record struct ItemWithNullKey<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key)\n                {\n                    [Key((string)null!)]\n                    public int NullKeyStructProperty { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using Lib;\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace App\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial class DerivedWithNullKeyBase : MetadataBaseWithNullKey\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public int DerivedProperty { get; set; }\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public sealed partial record CmdWithNullKey([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n                {\n                    [Key(1)]\n                    public ItemWithNullKey<int> Member { get; init; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = await CreateCompilationWithMetadataReferenceAsync(libSource, appSource);\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out _, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\");\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await compilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning);\n        Assert.All(analyzerDiagnostics, d =>\n        {\n            Assert.True(d.Location.IsInSource, $\"Unexpected non-source diagnostic: {d}\");\n            Assert.True(d.Location.SourceTree is not null && compilation.ContainsSyntaxTree(d.Location.SourceTree), $\"Diagnostic outside compilation: {d}\");\n        });\n    }\n}\n"}
